name: Dhiraj Ray
tagline: I build systems that connect Software, Data, Hardware, and AI.

about.short: Fresher developer with a strong foundation in Python, React, and AI & ML. I love building products that bridge the physical and digital worlds.
about.long: I'm an Electronics and Communication Engineering graduate who fell in love with software. Over the past two years I've built full-stack apps, IoT prototypes, and AI tools. I'm comfortable from PCB to PostgreSQL, from Arduino to AWS. Currently exploring Latest Frontend technology and edge AI.

philosophy.title: Build Clean
philosophy.description: Fast endpoints, clear architecture, zero bloat. If it doesn't add value, it doesn't belong in the codebase.

philosophy.title: Don't Do It Twice
philosophy.description: Computers are built for boring work. I automate repetitive tasks so humans can solve the hard problems.

philosophy.title: No Ivory Towers
philosophy.description: Code is built for people. I write clear documentation and design APIs that make life easy for whoever touches them next.

background.intro: When the IDE is closed, my brain doesn't stop optimizing. The same mindset that drives my code runs my personal world.

sections.title: Strategic Sandboxes & Tacticals
sections.content: I view gaming through an engineering lens. Whether I am architecting complex automated systems in Minecraft survival or executing tight, calculated rotations with a team in BGMI, it's all optimization and risk management under a different skin.

sections.title: Structural Storytelling
sections.content: I have a deep appreciation for the high-stakes narrative scales and razor-sharp character designs found in modern manga and anime. Analyzing the tactical depth of Jujutsu Kaisen or the absolute scale of One-Punch Man satisfies my love for brilliant, creative world-building.
